title: Monster Opera
shareTitle: Monster Opera — Make a Monster Chorus
description: Tap fuzzy singers, compare pitches, layer a chorus, and perform a tiny replayable opera on a playful stage.
learningGoals: Compare low, middle, and high pitch
Hear how timbre, rhythm, and musical layers combine

feedbackModel: Each tap produces an immediate monster phrase with authored mouth flaps, blinking, finger-following gaze poses, and a squash animation; selections gain a compact gold check badge and every combination stays consonant.
